metadata.oracle_evidence: solution/trajectory.npz replays the validated Sharpa Wave authoring trajectory on the Marvin right arm (2,416 controls; success after 2,266, the last 150 rows are hold slack) in both modes: two fresh-process replays with identical state hashes, also with the rows rounded to float32; standard mode streams the same rows through the public client.

notes.layout: Each row starts with the 14 Marvin arm joint targets (left arm J1-J7, then right arm J1-J7), followed by the left hand's finger targets and then the right hand's (22 per hand for `sharpa`, 20 per hand for `wuji`); the left arm is parked and only the right arm/hand perform the task; one row is one 50 Hz control (ten 2 ms physics substeps).
